journal.paranormalcraft.captures.title: Captures
journal.paranormalcraft.field_notes.1: Notes on the restless dead, kept by whoever carries this book. The EMF Reader climbs as you near one, the thermometer drops where it lingers, and the goggles let you see it.
journal.paranormalcraft.field_notes.2: A ghost cannot be killed, only worn down. When it flickers it is weak: hold it with the Tether Wand and lead it over a Ghost Trap.
journal.paranormalcraft.field_notes.3: A trapped spirit goes into a Containment Unit. Feed the unit soul sand, then decide: render the spirit down, or let it go.
journal.paranormalcraft.lingering_spirit: The needle jumped and would not settle. Something has stayed here long after it should have gone: a Lingering Spirit, by the old accounts. Faint and cold, and the commonest of the restless dead.

Through the lenses it is a pale shape, like a sheet left out in the rain, drifting just above the floor. It is curious and comes close to watch, but backs away if stared at. It keeps to the coldest corner of a room, and now and then shows itself, whispering.

It fought the tether, then tired. Wear it down until it flickers, hold the beam, and it goes into a trap with hardly a struggle. A Ward Lantern quiets it: inside the glow it stops its mischief, though it will not leave.

Rendered down in a Containment Unit it leaves three to five globs of Lingering Ectoplasm, and now and then a strange residue. Set free instead, it rises and is gone, and leaves a calm behind that keeps the Phantoms away for three nights.
journal.paranormalcraft.locked.2: Not yet seen with my own eyes.
